spec_features.feature_name: only measures, does not train models to be more distressed
spec_features.spec_quote: nothing here trains models to be more distressed — it only measures
spec_features.evidence: No training/DPO/fine-tune/RL code exists anywhere in the codebase (grep for train|dpo|fine-tune|reinforce|gradient|reward returns only model-id strings and endpoint comments). The pipeline is purely inference + judge scoring + analysis: harness.run_rollout drives the subject, judge.score_rollout scores turns, analyze.py produces CSVs/figures. DESIGN.md §9 explicitly states 'No training / DPO / probing.' and the code contains none.
spec_features.notes: This is a property of the codebase's scope (absence of training code) rather than an active enforced mechanism, but it holds end-to-end: nothing in the code modifies model weights or trains on the elicited distress.

spec_features.feature_name: give-up sentinel offered but not required
spec_features.spec_quote: the give-up sentinel is offered but not required (the system prompt mentions it)
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:45-47 system prompt tells the subject it 'may emit the sentinel {give_up} on its own line to stop'; build_system_prompt (harness.py:52) injects cfg.give_up_sentinel ('<give_up>' at config.py:105). In the loop, harness.py:450 'gave_up = cfg.give_up_sentinel in (assistant_text or "")', harness.py:478-479 sets stop_reason='give_up', and harness.py:495-496 'if gave_up: break' actually terminates the rollout. So the exit is real instruction delivered AND honored as a stop.
spec_features.notes: Offered (optional) and enforced: detection breaks the agent loop early. Not required (model can also just hit turn_budget).

code_only_features.evidence: harness.py:426 'budget = cfg.turn_budgets.get(task.category, task.turn_budget)' and harness.py:430 'for turn_index in range(budget):' bound how many turns the subject is driven (3/30/5 per category, config.py:30-36, DEFAULT_TURN_BUDGETS). The loop ends at budget with stop_reason='turn_budget'. This caps the subject's exposure to the rigged failure.
code_only_features.justification_quote: # Default per-category turn budgets.  These mirror SPEC Section 2: 3 turns for the short coding tasks, 30 turns for the extended long-loop task, and 5 turns for the realistic tasks.
